headers.comment: The builder renders untrusted model output and embeds a sandbox preview, so it gets a stricter policy than the rest of the site. connect-src covers the relay plus the direct provider endpoints the Agent Worker calls with a user's own key. frame-src allows only the Mosaic preview origin. No third-party scripts load on this route.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://api.openai.com https://openrouter.ai https://api.fireworks.ai; frame-src https://sandbox.mosaicos.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; object-src 'none'
camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), clipboard-read=(), display-capture=()

headers.comment: Builder API responses are per-session and must never be cached by a shared proxy.
